mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about poverty measurement: 1. Absolute poverty can be measured against a fixed line such as the World Bank international poverty line. 2. Relative poverty is widely used in developed economies. 3. Relative poverty is defined exclusively by a fixed calorie norm. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcq_fix.why: statement 1 as worded implied absolute poverty is only measured by the World Bank line

mcq_fix.s: As per World Bank estimates of 2016, which country had the largest number of people living below the international poverty line?
mcq_fix.why: stem referred to 'APPSC 2016' instead of the fact

mcq_fix.s: The international poverty line revised by the World Bank in June 2025 is:

mcq_drop.why: opinion item ('best represents the contemporary debate')

patterns: APPSC asks the committee line figure directly (Rangarajan rural Rs 32/day) and the $1.90 = 2011 PPP World Bank line.
Basis of poverty line (household consumption expenditure, calorie intake, NSSO) is the most repeated PSC fact.
Types-of-poverty and Oscar Lewis 'culture of poverty' appear as single-fact or 'which are types' items.
Traps: Tendulkar Rs 816/1000 vs Rangarajan Rs 972/1407; $2.15 (2022) vs $3.00 (2025).
App adds FGT formula and MMRP statement items that are deeper than PYQs but sound; also some opinion/debate items.
